comment: First-person M02 audio capture through the floor Crawler pair. A joined human and real server trigger the underlying gameplay stages. WAVs are ignored listening candidates, not proof that every cue is audible.

states.name: gallery_arrival
states.note: Arrival on the observation gallery. The ward view and Latch presentation are still graybox work.

states.name: shotgun_discovery
states.note: The guaranteed Shotgun is visible ahead on the upper gallery before it is claimed.

states.name: upper_gallery_loadout
states.note: The player collects the Shotgun and Shells before entering the guard room.

states.name: seated_guard_room
states.note: Two Clerks wait with weapons down at the guard-room table before their encounter activates.

states.name: guard_room_fight
states.note: Both guard-room Clerks defeated after the Shotgun pickup and before the stairs.

states.name: crawler_scrabble
states.note: The first Crawler's positional scrabble and live caption arrive from below the switchback before the player has a clear view of the lower landing.

states.name: crawler_solo
states.note: The player moves down the switchback during the first Crawler attack, evades its locked leap, then defeats it on the grounded landing without losing HP.

states.name: maintenance_fork
states.note: After the lone Crawler, a grounded service opening is visible west of the direct lane to the pack landing.

states.name: maintenance_cut
states.note: The player takes the service cut to the antechamber while the pack landing remains a separate direct approach.

states.name: ward_fight
states.note: The bypass rejoins before the ward; its guards fall and correction halts before the restraint is opened.

states.name: latch_restrained
states.note: Latch remains at the closed restraint until the player reaches the local frame control.

states.name: ward_exit_held
states.note: The only floor exit is a closed shutter before the player releases Latch.

states.name: latch_release
states.note: A real F press at the ward frame releases Latch once. The nearby panel fills this audio route's view; the separate evacuation tour covers the visual mechanism.

states.name: second_bay_open
states.note: Latch reaches the second bay while the joined fighter stays near the first frame. This state captures the mechanism audio and stage, not a clear full-bay view.

states.name: low_water_list
states.note: The transfer list names Low Water in captions. The joined fighter remains in the ward for the final release audio.

states.name: latch_handoff
states.note: The server-owned Latch completes their second-bay action before the party advances.

states.name: ward_exit_open
states.note: The same shutter is raised after Latch's release, without a second player switch.

states.name: floor_entry_fight
states.note: The first floor crew pressures the shutter and the raised officer lane while Latch supports.

states.name: floor_crossfire_fight
states.note: The player can fight the machinery crossing from cover while four responders take the main and side return lanes.

states.name: floor_crawler_warning
states.note: A live floor Crawler warning and caption come from the floor pair over the nearby processing machinery bed before that pair is fought.

states.name: floor_crawler_pair
states.note: The final Crawler pair can be fought before the dock watch while the player holds the floor cover.
